title.zh: 股票特徵交互效果於報酬率預測的重要性：基於 SHAP-IQ 框架的實證分析
title.en: The Importance of Stock Feature Interactions in Return Prediction: An Empirical Analysis Based on the SHAP-IQ Framework

plain.zh: 股價報酬預測模型為什麼會失準？這篇用台灣股市 1991–2023 年的資料、110 個價格、財務、技術與市場特徵，以滾動視窗訓練 XGBoost，再用 SHAP-IQ 量化「哪些特徵組合在一起」造成預測誤差，並追蹤這些組合隨市場環境的變化，給出一套診斷模型的方法。
plain.en: Why do return-prediction models go wrong? Using Taiwan stock data from 1991 to 2023 and 110 price, financial, technical and market features, this thesis trains XGBoost on rolling windows and uses SHAP-IQ to measure which combinations of features drive the prediction errors, tracking how they change with the market, as a way to diagnose a model.

title.zh: 基於基金持股行為序列的個人投資推薦系統研究
title.en: Research on Personal Investment Recommendation System Based on Fund Holdings Behavior Sequences

plain.zh: 不用個人交易資料，也能推薦投資組合嗎？這篇改用公開的基金持股資料，把新投資人的偏好對應到相似的基金，再用「下一籃推薦」模型預測基金下一期的持股。時間感知的近鄰模型 TIFUKNN 與注意力模型 DNNTSP 在多數指標上表現最好；所有模型都很會預測「繼續持有」，較難預測「新買進」，反映基金決策相當穩定。
plain.en: Can we recommend portfolios without anyone’s personal trades? This thesis uses public fund holdings instead, maps a new investor’s preferences to similar funds, and predicts each fund’s next holdings with next-basket recommendation models. The time-aware neighbour model TIFUKNN and the attention model DNNTSP do best on most metrics; every model predicts holdings that are kept well but new purchases poorly, a sign of how stable fund decisions are.

title.zh: SeqTAG：條件式格蘭傑因果圖與拓撲自適應圖卷積於台灣股市投資組合建構之應用
title.en: SeqTAG: Conditional Granger causality graphs and topology-adaptive graph convolution for portfolio construction in the Taiwan stock market

plain.zh: 台股之間誰會影響誰？這篇用條件式 Granger 因果檢定建出股票之間的預測關係圖，再用拓樸自適應圖卷積（TAGCN）在一層內看多跳的影響。在因果路徑最深的股票上，擴大範圍仍能維持或提升預測力（IC、RankIC）；就全體股票而言，排序品質和方向準確率（高於 50%）勝過不用圖的 GRU 與相關係數圖，但風險調整後報酬仍是不用圖的模型最好。
plain.en: Which Taiwan stocks lead which? This thesis builds a graph of predictive links between stocks with conditional Granger causality tests, then uses topology-adaptive graph convolution (TAGCN) to see multi-hop influence in a single layer. On the stocks with the deepest causal paths, widening the view keeps or improves predictive power (IC, RankIC); across all stocks it ranks better and gets direction right more than half the time, beating a graph-free GRU and a correlation graph, though the graph-free model still has the best risk-adjusted return.

title.zh: 基於共同基金持股序列之下一籃推薦模型研究：DNNTSP 與外部特徵融合之實證分析
title.en: Next-Basket Recommendation for Mutual Fund Holdings Prediction: An Empirical Analysis of DNNTSP with External Feature Fusion

plain.zh: 基金下一季會持有哪些股票？這篇把它當成「下一籃推薦」問題，用 CRSP 2014–2024 年 17,203 檔基金的季度持股訓練 DNNTSP，比較加入股票特徵、基金特徵的四種版本。結果四種版本表現接近：基金持股的延續性很高，上一季的持股本身就是最強的訊號，外部特徵的幫助有限。
plain.en: Which stocks will a fund hold next quarter? This thesis treats it as next-basket recommendation, training DNNTSP on CRSP quarterly holdings of 17,203 funds from 2014 to 2024 and comparing four versions with and without stock and fund features. All four perform about the same: holdings carry over strongly from quarter to quarter, last quarter’s portfolio is already the strongest signal, and the extra features add little.
